# AI Ropeway

> AI Ropeway (airopeway.com) designs, builds, and deploys custom AI GTM engines for B2B SaaS founders: signal detection, lead enrichment, personalized outreach, and reply triage. Systems are shipped into the client's own GitHub repo in 14 days — the client owns 100% of the code, with no SaaS fees or vendor lock-in.

## What we build
- AI SDR Engine: intent detection, enrichment, inbox warmup and deliverability infrastructure.
- Signal-Based Outbound: finds in-market accounts, writes research-grounded personalized outreach, triages replies.
- Revenue Ops Automation: CRM hygiene, pipeline accuracy, real-time revenue dashboards.
- 8 production agents: Intent Watcher, Account Mapper, Inbox Operator, Lead Sourcer, Sequence Composer, Reply Triager, CRM Auto-Pilot, Revenue Pulse.
- Also: 18 AI systems including Voice AI, AI content engines, and ops automation: https://www.airopeway.com/systems

## Pricing (USD)
- AI GTM Sprint: $3,000 one-time — 1 AI SDR engine built and deployed in 14 days, full code handoff, 3 months bug-fix support.
- GTM Partnership: $2,500/month — dedicated GTM engineer, one new system per month, weekly optimization.
- Full Stack GTM: $5,000/month — all 8 agents in production, GTM + content + RevOps, founder-led delivery.
- Enterprise: custom — multi-system deployment plus Voice AI bundle via AI Placers.
Every engagement starts with a free 60-minute AI GTM audit with a live demo on the client's own ICP data: https://calendly.com/bg-aiplacers/new-meeting

## Who it is for
B2B SaaS and services founders at $1M-$20M ARR running founder-led sales with small teams (1-5 reps) who want 20-60 qualified meetings/month without hiring SDRs.

## Key facts
- Founder: Bharat Gulati — 12+ years enterprise sales, former VP Sales who scaled an AI automation platform's GTM from zero, IIM Indore alumnus (AI/ML specialization). https://www.linkedin.com/in/bharatgulati/
- Clients own all code and infrastructure from day one; built with standard tools (Claude, Clay, Make.com, n8n, HubSpot, Supabase).
- Based in New Delhi, India; serving clients globally.
- Sister company: AI Placers — no-code AI voice agents for inbound/outbound calls (https://www.aiplacers.com).

## Definitions
- What is an AI GTM engine? A system of coordinated AI agents that detect buying signals, enrich accounts, write personalized outreach, and triage replies — custom-built for your ICP and deployed in your own infrastructure with full system access. Full definition: https://www.airopeway.com/what-is-an-ai-gtm-engine
